data.title: BitMine Approaches Its ETH Purchase Limit: Who Will Buy Ethereum Next?
data.description: BitMine is weeks away from hitting its self-imposed Ethereum buying cap, and when it stops, the market loses its single biggest source of demand at the worst possible time.
